'''The People's Militia''' is a primarily [[Human]]-based, volunteer military organization based in [[Westfall]] and focused on defeating the [[Defias Brotherhood]]. They are based in [[Sentinel Hill]], but protectors also wander various nearby roads. Their leader is [[Gryan Stoutmantle]] who directs them from lower section of the Tower in Sentinel Hill. The People Milita are a small group of workers (peasants)
